title: Matamshi Bora (Theme 1: Viungo vya mwili vya ndani)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 6 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child hears the one feature that separates d/nd, ch/sh, j/nj na g/ng and checks the meaning of the word before writing it.

floor.prerequisite: Says the five vowels and reads open syllables (ba, be, bi, bo, bu).
floor.question: Soma: ja-a

representations: a hand on the throat to feel the voice (or the lips for a nasal)
a picture for each meaning (to be full, hunger)
steps: Think of the meaning in the sentence.
Write it and read it back.
contexts: viungo vya mwili vya ndani (internal organs)
a word game in the playground

board.do: Point at the first letter of each word.
board.say: Neno lipi lina maana ya "to be full"?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes both words under their pictures and says each one.

misconceptions.ask: Neno "jaa" lina maana gani, na "njaa" lina maana gani?
misconceptions.repair: "jaa" ni to be full; "njaa" ni hunger. Sauti moja hubadilisha maana.
Neno lenye maana ya "a chart" ni "chati". "shati" lina maana ya "a shirt".

misconceptions.ask: Ukibadilisha neno moja kwa jingine katika sentensi, maana inabaki ileile?
misconceptions.repair: Hapana. "chati" ni a chart, na "shati" ni a shirt.

listen_for: Moyo husukuma damu mwilini kila wakati.
misconceptions.ask: Ni sauti gani zinarudiwa katika sentensi hii?
misconceptions.repair: Kitanzandimi hurudia sauti zinazokaribiana, kama d/nd, ch/sh, j/nj na g/ng, ili kiwe kigumu kutamka.

misconceptions.ask: Kila silabi inaishia kwa herufi gani?
misconceptions.repair: Kila silabi ya Kiswahili huishia kwa irabu: nja-a.

checks.question: Andika neno lenye maana ya "a shirt".
Ni kipi ni kitanzandimi?
checks.answer: Njaa ya Njeri ilijaa njiani, akanywa chai na kula ndizi ndani ya nyumba ndogo.
